flags.title: Published inventory does not reconcile with Hotspawn's own fixtures API
flags.detail: Hotspawn's API listed 97 CS2 fixtures when read at 2026-10-16T11:21:13Z; the deployed snapshot published 101 rows generated at 2026-10-16T08:18:38Z. Missing from the site: none. Published but no longer listed by Hotspawn: ['1079630', '1080286', '1080287', '1081493'], of which 3 had already passed their scheduled start when the API was read (1081493, 1080286, 1079630). Hotspawn's fixtures feed is queried with status=scheduled, so a fixture leaves it once it starts; that part is a timing difference between two readings, not a coverage gap.
